text:
maria: Heads-up  SummitBank wants a minimal compliance packet before we flip the switch on a 30-day Dedicated POC. Their inbox asks for: SOC 2 control mapping (not the full report), ISO 27001 scope/certificate excerpt, signed pen-test authorization, a brief KMS custody statement for the POC, and a simple VPC/network diagram. They also want to know if Dedicated POC pricing can be made refundable. Need it before their legal kickoff next Wed.

devon: Copy. Clarify: do they want any sample logs? We normally give sanitized examples + policy excerpts. Raw logs require DPA amendment.

maria: Customer replied: "policy excerpts + control mapping + signed pen-letter + KMS note is sufficient. No raw logs unless we sign a DPA addendum."

tarun: I'll assemble the SOC2 control->evidence mapping and the ISO excerpt. Plan: a 2-page mapping + links to artifact locations (presigned s3 paths) and notes on redaction. ETA: tomorrow AM.

devon: KMS custody options: (1) Redwood-managed keys (keys not exportable), or (2) customer BYOK (HSM) for Private. For a short Dedicated POC we can provide a short custody statement describing option (1) and migration path to BYOK. I'll draft 3-4 sentence blurb.

sophie-legal: For the pen-test authorization we need vendor name, test window, and target IPs/CIDR. Typical minimal review time is ~48 business hours. If you want a signed letter before Fri, provide vendor + CIDR today.

infra-bot: NOTE: NET-TICKET-9901 created to generate a simplified VPC diagram and reserve a /28 for the POC if they confirm Dedicated. Diagram estimate: 36 hrs post-confirmation.

devon: Pen-letter draft suggestion: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor name] to conduct coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against the following targets during [start date]  [end date]: [IP/CIDR list]. Testing must be scheduled with Redwood SRE at least 72 hours in advance, be limited to agreed targets, and must not exfiltrate or alter customer data. Critical vulnerabilities must be reported to Redwood Security immediately.
```

maria: Pricing Q: they asked about a refundable 30/60/90-day option. Short answer: Dedicated normally requires a commit; sales can request a commercial exception for a short refundable trial with finance. @pricing-bot can you surface options?

pricing-bot: PROPOSAL: option A) Hosted PAYG (no commit). Option B) 60-day Dedicated trial with 50% of MRR as refundable deposit (prorated refund before day 30). Option C) 90-day Dedicated commit standard pricing (non-refundable). I'll connect to billing ops for exact numbers.

tarun: I'll mark which evidence items are redaction-required (PII, full SAML assertions) and which are ok to share (policy excerpts, config screenshots).

sophie-legal: I'll prioritize the pen-letter review if we get vendor + desired window. Also can approve a minimal signature for coordination-only letters (no liability changes) faster.

maria: Action items: Tarun - SOC2 mapping + ISO excerpt (tom AM), Devon - KMS custody blurb + pen-letter draft (today), Sophie - legal review when vendor+CIDR provided (48 hrs), Infra - NET-TICKET-9901 for diagram after Dedicated confirm, Pricing-bot - follow up with billing ops for refundable trial numbers. I'll update the customer with these timelines and book a Fri sync.
